## Navimower Map Card 0.3.5-beta3

### Mobile scheduler interaction fixes
- Replace Android's native `select` popup for Add zone with an in-card dropdown menu. The scheduler no longer opens a full-screen system selector or loses the selection while Home Assistant state updates arrive.
- Keep Add zone scoped to configured scheduler zones that are still missing from the local draft, and disable it when every configured zone is already represented.
- Rework touch drag-and-drop to use queue-row geometry (`getBoundingClientRect`) instead of `document.elementFromPoint()`, avoiding Home Assistant/Companion App Shadow DOM retargeting problems.
- Capture drag pointer events at the scheduler root, preserve the row DOM while dragging, support edge auto-scroll, and finish cleanly on pointer up, cancel or lost pointer capture.
- Keep queue changes local until `Save order`; Start/End remain Home Assistant native controls with immediate saves.

### Per-mower scheduler isolation
- Treat Navimower 0.4.3-beta44+ Map API frontend metadata as authoritative for the current mower.
- If the current mower has no managed `schedule_status`, do not search for or borrow another mower's single global scheduler status.
- Remove the unsafe `single_global_status` fallback from the effective discovery path and fall back to that mower's native schedule view when managed scheduling is not configured.
- Preserve registry discovery only for older integrations that do not expose per-mower frontend metadata.
